1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses QUALIFICATION OF TENDERERS & DEFINITION OF SIMILAR WORK (PQC) Evaluation will be done based on the documents submitted by the tenderers. No correspondence shall be made after opening of technical part regarding any missing document. Only such firms need tender who can produce satisfactory evidence that they have the necessary experience & financial resources and organization to undertake such work as per criteria mentioned below. i) The Tenderer’s average annual turnover for the work during last 03 years, ending 31st March of the previous financial year, should be at least 30% of estimated value i.e Rs. 5.10 Lakhs in Audited balance sheet & profit & loss account of each year must be submitted by the tenderer. ii) Experience of having successfully completed Hiring of Heavy vehicle like JCB/ Pay Loader /Poclain / Tipper during last 07 years ending last day of month previous to the one in which application are invited should be either of the following: a) One single similar completed job costing not less than 80% of estimated value i.e Rs. 13.58 Lakhs or b) Two similar completed jobs costing not less than 50% of estimated value each i.e Rs. 8.49 Lakhs or c) Three similar completed jobs costing not less than 40% of estimated value each i.e Rs. 6.79 Lakhs SIMILAR WORK Similar work means Hiring of Heavy vehicle like JCB/ Pay Loader/ Poclain/ Tipper. The contractor will have to submit copy of the work order as well as the completion certificate from the concern department in support of their experience/ credential. Party should also have to submit PAN No., PF No., GST No. GEOGRAPHICAL PRESENCE: Office registration certificate (registered office or at least one of the registered branch office of the bidder shall be located and registered within the geographical limits of Jharkhand state where the services needs to be provided).

Documentary evidence must be provided in the form of Municipality trade licence or other such documents as per the following which satisfies as a proof of having the office establishment. a) Trade Licence issued by the local authority in the name of the firm or b) Landline phone number in the name of the firm. c) Electricity bill for the last one year in the name of the Firm or d) GSTIN registration or e) Udyam /MSME/Udyog Aadhar certificate. f) Office rent agreement is not acceptable/ not valid. The bidder must submit documentary evidence of the ownership of the JCB along with the Tender Document. In case of a brand new machine, the bidder will have to submit the evidence of booking of new machine along with the offer. In case of any ambiguity, Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC of GEM will supersede the GEM GTC. . 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT 1. Contractor should provide JCB mounted rock breaker. The JCB Rock breaker shall be in good working co ndition with good seat, tyres, bucket etc. The supplied machine shall have year of manufacturing on or aft er 1st January 2022 which will be effective after 03 months of equipment deployed. UCIL has the right to in spect the vehicles in details. 2. The contractor shall be the owner of the JCB Rock breaker. Leased or hired JCB is not acceptable. 3. The JCB rock breaker shall be registered as a commercial vehicle and shall have bucket capacity of 1.0 / 0.25 m3 or above. There should be a provision of changing of bucket with a Rock breaker & vice-versa, depending upon use. 4. The JCB with rock breaker shall be supplied along with competent operators with necessary valid license, permits for the contract period. 5. All the documents connected with the JCB rock breaker, driver’s license and road permit etc.shall always be available in the vehicle. 6. All the maintenance and related expenses will be borne by contractor like engine oil, lubricant, air & lub e filter and any other consumables except diesel. The tenderer is allowed to take the vehicle for repair / maintenance on any one day in a month, subject to the convenience of the user (UCIL). 7. PPE shall be provided by the contractor and in case of failing to provide, the same shall be provided by UCIL and necessary deduction shall be done from the R.A bills. 8. In case of quality of PPE not up to the mark as per Engineer-in-charge satisfaction, he may ask to change the same and incase of failure of contractor to change, the same shall be provided by UCIL and nec essary deduction shall be done from by the R.A bills. 9. IME, PME and VTC shall be done by contractor at your own cost.

10. Weekly day of rest of operators shall be defined by the contractor. 11. Contractor has to deployed 03 (three) nos. of operators on all days i.e., each of 8 hours duration includ ing Sundays and holidays. 12. No operator shall work for more than 8 hours. In case of operator has work for more than 8 hours, contr actor shall give overtime at the rate of double his normal wages to operators. 13. The JCB Rock breaker will be provided for full day & paid for keeping the JCB rock breaker along with o perator in the plant. Apart from this, diesel will be provided free of cost by the Corporation from the Turam dih Stores, based on the hour meter. Diesel will be provided free of cost @ 6 litres/ Hrs. as per hour meter reading. 14. The operator will have to regularly get the logbook containing the details of running hours countersign ed by the Engineer-in-charge. 15. UCIL reserves the right to inspect the JCB loader with rock breaker in detail and if the condition of the JCB loader is not found satisfactory, then the Corporation reserves the right to reject the JCB loader without assigning any reason. 16. Payment of operators shall be done before 7th date of every month. 17. Monthly R.A bills and one final bill will be paid for this work. 18. Operator must be well behaved and in case of any complaint he shall be suitably substituted by you wi thin one week. Accommodation of the operator is the contractor responsibility. 19. Taxes & insurances: Payment of taxes & insurance of the JCB rock breaker and operators is the respons ibility of the contractor. 20. Identity card/gate pass would be issued to the operator of the JCB rock breaker for entry into the UCIL p remises. 21. The contractor will have to comply with the provisions of OSHWC Code 2020, OSHWC (Central) Rule 20 26, contract labour act (Regulation & Abolition) 1970, EPF & MP Act 152 & Central Rules frame their under, Minimum Wages Act 1948, SOP, DGMS Circulars. 22. In case of unavailability of the JCB Rock breaker for more than 08 hours for any reason UCIL reserves th e right to engage JCB Rock breaker from any other source at risk & cost of the contractor. 23. The contractor will have to deploy the JCB Rock breaker for round the clock inside the company premis es. 24. The bidder must submit documentary evidence of the ownership of the JCB along with the tender docu ment. In case of a brand new machine the bidder will have to submit the evidence of booking of new machi ne along with the offer. 25. Penalty: a) In case of unavailability of JCB rock breaker either because of breakdown of JCB rock breaker or unavailability of operator or any other case for more than 3 hrs but less than 12 hrs 50% of the daily hire charges shall be deducted as penalty. b) In case of unavailability of JCB rock breaker for more than 12 hrs. but less than 24 hrs. 100% of the daily hire charges shall be deducted as penalty. c) In case of unavailability of JCB rock breaker for more than one day and not supplying substitute JCB load er, then actual hire charges of substitute JCB rock breaker by the corporation shall be charged as penalty or 15 hrs awarded hiring charges will be deducted as penalty. d) In case of unavailability of JCB rock breaker for more than 8 hrs. a day for more than 4 occasion in a mon th, additional of 8 hrs hiring charges will be deducted from monthly bill. e) In case of higher unavailability than above the Corporation reserves the right to cancel the contract. 26. Scope of work: The JCB mounted Rock breaker will mainly be used for breaking of ore or any other rock /material into ground hopper grizzly. However, the JCB may also be used for any other type of works anyw

here inside or outside the Turamdih unit/area, depending upon the requirement and as instructed by the E ngineer-in-charge. 27. The quoted rate should be inclusive of all taxes & duties i.e., GST. PF & Bonus is applicable as per the n orms of UCIL. 28. No Escalation shall be paid against this work. Contractor has to pay the increased labour rate with arre ars payment, if any increase in minimum wages. Contractor has to pay Bonus and PF. 29. Quantity of individual items may vary to any extent and be excluded altogether. You will carry out all works up to a total variation of + 10% (Ten) on the contract price and all quoted rate shall remain firm wit hin this limit. 30. Time and quantity (upto 10%) extension may be taken on urgency with prior approval of competent au thority. 31. The party should have their registered office / branch in Jharkhand state. As they have to renal their Se rvice Engineer / representative to attend any breakdown within 8 hrs. reporting of machine. 32. Contractor has to comply, leave with wages as per new OSHWC code 2020 section 32. Every worker e mployed in a mine shall be entitled for leave in a calendar year with wages subject to the following conditi ons:- i) that he has worked one hundred and eighty (180) days or more in such calendar year; ii) that he shall be entitled for one (1) day leave for every twenty (20) days of his work, in such calendar ye ar; 33.
